title: The Mango Thief of the Village
custom_script:
# Scene: Village
Peddy: {look-around} Look at those golden *mangoes* shining in the sun! {point} [excited, point, wow]
Teddy: {hmm} My stomach is already singing a *song* of hunger. {rub-belly} [happy, think, giggle]
Peddy: {walk-to} Let's grab them before someone else beats us to it! {run} [excited, run, shout]
Teddy: {shake:tree} Wait for me! I am the ultimate *thief*! {jump} [excited, jump, yay]
# Scene: Village
Peddy: {climb:mango tree} I'm at the top! Look at this massive *fruit*! {point} [excited, point, wow]
Teddy: {shake:tree} Shake the branch! Make it *rain* mangoes! {shout} [excited, wave, shout]
Peddy: {pick:mango} Catch this giant one, Teddy! {throw:mango} [happy, throw, whoosh]
Teddy: {eat:mango} {yay} Oh, pure heaven! So sweet and *juicy*! [happy, idle, eat, yum]
# Time skip: Ten minutes later…
# Scene: Village
Farmer: {angry} Hey! Who is stealing my prize *mangoes*?! {shout} [angry, hips, shout, horn]
Peddy: {shock} Run! It's the angry *farmer*! {run} [surprised, run, gasp, footsteps]
Teddy: {hide:bush} {uff} My life flashed before my *eyes*! {sweat} [scared, shrug, uff]
Farmer: {look-around} I will find whoever touched my *tree*! {angry} [angry, point, shout]
# Scene: Village
Peddy: {whisper} That was way too close for *comfort*. {gasp} [surprised, think, whisper]
Teddy: {idea} But I still have one *mango* in my pocket! {gasp} [excited, point, ding]
Peddy: {haan} Give it here! We need to share our *loot*! {grab} [happy, point, haan]
Teddy: {eat:mango} {oops} Oops, I just dropped it in the *river*! {facepalm} [sad, shrug, oops]
# Scene: Village
Peddy: {go:river} Oh no! The river stole our *breakfast*! {cry} [sad, cry, splash]
Teddy: {swim:river} I'll dive in and rescue that *mango*! {jump} [excited, swim, splash]
Peddy: {shout} Watch out for the giant *fish* down there! {fear} [surprised, point, shout]
Teddy: {look:fish} Eek! That fish looks like a *monster*! {scared} [surprised, step-back, gasp]
# Time skip: Five minutes later…
# Scene: Village
Teddy: {cross:bridge} {huff} I survived the river of *doom*. {sweat} [sad, shrug, phew]
Peddy: {sit:bench} Look, there is a basket of *apples* by the well! {point} [surprised, point, ding]
Teddy: {sniff} Apples? But we are on a *mango* mission! {shake-head} [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {eat} A thief cannot be too *choosy*, my friend. {laugh} [happy, idle, munch]
# Scene: Village
Villager: {angry} Hey thieves! Those apples are for the village *fair*! {shout} [angry, hips, shout, slap]
Teddy: {run} Run away! The whole village is *chasing* us! {run} [surprised, run, scream, footsteps]
Peddy: {hide:box} Quick, hide inside this wooden *box*! {push} [surprised, hide, push]
Villager: {look-around} Where did those little *rascals* go?! {angry} [angry, look-around, shout]
# Time skip: Two minutes later…
# Scene: Village
Teddy: {wake} I think the coast is *clear* now. {gasp} [calm, idle, phew]
Peddy: {facepalm} We came for mangoes and got chased by a *mob*. {sigh} [sad, shrug, fail]
Teddy: {idea} {light-fire} Let's build a campfire and make *tea* instead. {clap} [excited, point, ding]
Peddy: {drink} Ah, warm tea heals a broken *thief* heart. {sip} [happy, idle, sip]
# Scene: Village
Goat: {look:goat} {show:goat} Baa! You are sitting on my favorite *rock*! {shout} [surprised, point, shout]
Teddy: {shock} Since when do goats speak *human*?! {gasp} [surprised, point, gasp]
Goat: {kick} Move before I headbutt your *pants* off! {fight} [angry, kick, punch]
Peddy: {run} Even the animals are against our *heist*! {run} [surprised, run, scream, footsteps]
# Time skip: A few moments later…
# Scene: Village
Teddy: {climb:tree} Up here, the goats cannot reach our *feet*! {yay} [happy, wave, yay]
Peddy: {look-around} Look back at the farmer's *tree*! {point} [surprised, point, wow]
Teddy: {gasp} The farmer is eating our stolen *mangoes* himself! {shock} [surprised, point, gasp]
Peddy: {laugh} He stole them back from us by *accident*! {giggle} [happy, wave, laugh]
# Scene: Village
Farmer: {eat:mango} Ah, these mangoes taste like sweet *justice*! {shout} [happy, idle, yum]
Teddy: {whisper} Well, at least someone is enjoying the *fruit*. {smile} [calm, think, whisper]
Peddy: {sit:log} Next time, we buy our fruit from the *store*. {nod} [calm, idle, nod]
Teddy: {laugh} Where is the fun in *buying* things, Peddy? {wink} [happy, wave, laugh]
# Scene: Village
Dog: {show:dog} Woof! I found another hidden *mango* right here! {bark} [excited, idle, shout, horn]
Peddy: {jump} A bonus mango?! Our luck has *changed*! {yay} [happy, jump, yay, boing]
Teddy: {eat:mango} {yay} Best worst heist *ever*! {cheer} [happy, wave, applause]
